test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Arrange the sentence parts:

(A) took care of (B) her younger brother (C) while their parents (D) were away
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (4)** i.e. **ABCD**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The sentence begins with the verb phrase "took care of," which is correctly indicated by **part (A).**
 
• Following the verb, the object of the action "her younger brother" is indicated by **part (B).**
 
• The next part, "while their parents," adds the context for the action, which is indicated by **part (C).**
 
• Finally, "were away" completes the sentence and provides the necessary conclusion, indicated by **part (D).**

Therefore, the correct sequence is **ABCD.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 1 (ACBD):** This option places "took care of" before "while their parents" without first introducing the object "her younger brother," which disrupts the logical flow.
 
• **Option 2 (BACD):** This option starts with "her younger brother" before introducing the action "took care of," which creates an unnatural sentence structure.
 
• **Option 3 (CBAD):** This option starts with "while their parents" before introducing the main subject "she," which is incorrect.

Note: This is a PYP question, and the official answer key has marked (correct option) as the correct answer, hence we cannot make any changes to it.
